contract.document_name.rationale: Title heading and preamble name the Services Agreement.

contract.effective_date.rationale: Term commences on 'the date hereof' (the Effective Date), which is the April 1, 2019 date of the agreement; other options are references, not the date.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: Minimum period of 12 months then by mutual agreement; no expiration date stated.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 13 applies the law of the State of New York; later mentions are court jurisdiction.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Continuation after the minimum period is by mutual agreement; no renewal term length.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No non-renewal notice provision; notice periods are for termination/resignation.
